title: Mixing: Front Parlour, All You Horse Riders, Frozen Jap, Blue Sway, Summer’s Day Song by Paul McCartney | 1979
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Eddie Klein

In the summer of 1979, Paul McCartney worked on a number of solo recordings in his home studio. A first mixing session for what would become the McCartney II album took place on 25 September.

Although intended as rough mixes, the stereo mix of ‘Front Parlour’ made on this day was included on the album. The other songs worked on were ‘Frozen Jap’, and the outtakes ‘You Know I’ll Get You Baby’, ‘All You Horse Riders’, ‘Blue Sway’, and an instrumental version of ‘Summer’s Day Song’.
